d: India is looking to procure major weapons systems after the country's Defence Acquisition Council, headed by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh approved the procurement of weapons for 2.2 Lakh Crore Rupees which is almost $22 Billion. Among the weapons that have been approved for procurement are the K-9 Vajra self-propelled howitzer, Kamikaze Drones, VSHORADS air-defence systems, Light Multi-Role Helicopters, Doppler Weather Radars and destroyers for the Indian Navy.
